blocks.content:
Rajya Sabha is the upper house and represents the states.
Composition:
• Maximum strength – 250 members
• 238 elected members
• 12 members nominated by the President

Rajya Sabha is a permanent house and cannot be dissolved.
Rajya Sabha is a permanent house and cannot be dissolved.

items: The exact number of members nominated by the President is 12.
The break-up of maximum strength: 238 elected + 12 nominated = 250 total.
Rajya Sabha is a permanent house and is NOT subject to dissolution.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Indian Parliament and represents the states.
The maximum strength of the Rajya Sabha is capped at 250 members.
The house consists of 238 elected representatives and 12 members nominated by the President.
Unlike Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha is a permanent house and cannot be dissolved.
